summary: Multi-team SaaS seat reallocation and cost-center proofing for quarterly billing
description: Issue summary: The Engineering Productivity team needs 150 seats reclassified across three cost centers for the new fiscal quarter. Current vendor console shows all seats billed to a single corporate cost center, which misattributes spend for individual product teams. Impact: Misreported spend in monthly engineering budget reports and blocked team-level headcount forecasting. Request: Reallocate 150 active seats from Cost Center CC-1100 to CC-1121 (Platform), CC-1123 (Core Infra), and CC-1150 (ML Platform) with prorated invoice adjustments for the current billing cycle. Also update SCIM mapping so new hires are auto-assigned to the appropriate team licenses going forward.
background: Vendor: Constellation Tools (contract through March 2027). Current contract scoped as centralized corporate billing. Engineering Productivity (requester) recently ran a headcount restructure and requested per-team billing for chargebacks. Procurement confirmed eligibility for seat reallocation in contract terms but requires written proof of cost-center mapping and an approval ticket from Finance. Previous related tickets: INT-48211 (license-seat-transfer-and-unused-seat-audit-request) highlighted similar reallocation steps last year.
requested_changes: 1) Reassign 60 seats to CC-1121 (Platform), 50 seats to CC-1123 (Core Infra), 40 seats to CC-1150 (ML Platform). 2) Update vendor billing contact and billing codes for the three cost centers. 3) Apply prorated credit/debit for current month based on usage days after reallocation. 4) Update SCIM group-to-license mapping: group.platform -> CC-1121 license pool, group.core-infra -> CC-1123, group.ml -> CC-1150. 5) Provide finance with a formal invoice adjustment memo and export of user-seat assignment CSV for audit.
steps_to_complete: Procurement: confirm contract allows seat-level reassignments and obtain vendor SLA on seat transfer timing (target 5 business days).
Finance: approve cost-center redistribution and provide billing codes and contact for each CC.
Vendor Admin: perform seat reallocation and issue prorated invoice credits/debits.
Identity/SSO: modify SCIM mapping in IdP to route new hires into correct groups. Verify existing users moved correctly.
Requestor: validate seat counts against active user list and confirm acceptance of invoice adjustments.
